legal.title: Policies & seller info
legal.grievanceBody: For any complaint about an order, product or payment, write to our grievance officer. We acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and resolve them within 30 days.
legal.privacySummary: We collect only what we need to deliver your orders: your name, email, phone, delivery addresses and order history. Location is used only when you tap "Use current location". We never sell your data. You can delete your account any time from Account > Profile.
legal.termsSummary: Prices include all taxes and are confirmed when you place the order. We may cancel an order if an item is unavailable or the address is outside our delivery area. Payment is cash on delivery.
legal.refundsSummary: You can cancel an order until the store starts packing it. If an item is missing, damaged or wrong, report it from the order page within 48 hours with a photo, and we'll make it right.
